description: This file contains the implementation of the Mail class within the OpenCart system, responsible for constructing and sending emails via different adaptors, with methods for setting email parameters such as recipient, sender, subject, message, and attachments.

classes.name: Mail
classes.description: A class for managing email composition and transmission using various adaptors.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Mail object by loading the specified email adaptor with options.

methods.name: setTo
methods.description: Sets the recipient(s) of the email.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the plain text message body of the email.

methods.name: setHtml
methods.description: Sets the HTML message body of the email.

methods.name: addAttachment
methods.description: Adds a file attachment to the email.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Validates email parameters and sends the email via the adaptor.
